scope: read-only source contract discovery; no HTTP calls, runtime, database, mutation, or Git operations

currency.stored_catalog_precision: Menu sell_price and order-type menu price are DECIMAL(10,2); extra-menu price is DECIMAL(10,2). Tax rate is DECIMAL(5,2). Transaction and payment amounts are DOUBLE.
currency.calculation: CartPricingService applies percentage taxes configured per order type and computes optional store rounding. It returns both total and rounded_total; Cart exposes price_after_tax and rounded_total_price separately.
currency.limits: No single integer-only/minor-unit wire contract found. TransactionService persists price_after_tax (not rounded_total_price), payment snapshot uses price_after_tax; client must not impose 10% tax or guess rounding. Database/model field mismatches below block relying on checkout success.

auth_scope.cart_and_transaction_routes: auth + infer-owner + infer-store; owner must provide query store_id, worker uses assigned store. Cart and transaction routes additionally require opened-store.
auth_scope.payment_route: POST /api/transactions/{transaction_id}/payment is declared under auth + infer-owner only; it lacks infer-store and opened-store although its request/controller read request attribute store.
